messages:
devon: Proposal — canary rollout config for model v3.1. Looking for quick alignment on percent ramps, holdpoints, and abort guards. Draft policy below, want defaults that are safe but not overly slow.

devon: Proposed JSON:
```
{
  "model": "redwood/model-v3.1",
  "strategy": "canary",
  "steps": [
    {"percent": 1, "duration": "30m"},
    {"percent": 5, "duration": "30m"},
    {"percent": 10, "duration": "60m", "hold": true},
    {"percent": 25, "duration": "60m"},
    {"percent": 50, "duration": "120m", "hold": true},
    {"percent": 100, "duration": "0m"}
  ],
  "guards": {
    "slo_error_rate_pct": 0.5,
    "latency_p99_ms": 2000,
    "abort_on": ["slo_breach","increased_anom"]
  },
  "telemetry_hooks": ["per-cohort-traces","sampled-requests"],
  "ui_flags": {"pause_on_deviation": true}
}
```

jason: +1 on holdpoints. I think max step jump should be 15% by default. Also add a rolling window TTL for cohorts (e.g., 2h) so we don't keep stale caches.

maria: defaults I'd pick: [1,5,10,25,50,100], step durations 30m/60m/120m as you have. Put explicit holdpoints at 10% and 50%. Also we should surface `abort_on` reasons in the console details so PMs can see why it paused. :eyes:

kevin: telemetry: we need per-cohort latency histograms + sample full request/response for 1/10k. Add `burst_protection` guard: if incoming qps > expected by 30% for 3 consecutive minutes, scale back to previous step.

sophia: UX: console control should show "preview cohorts" and allow toggle `auto-pause` (default on). Also display estimated cost delta per step. Field names: `preview_cohorts`, `auto_pause_on_deviation`, `estimated_cost_per_hr`.

devon: updated draft snippet with burst_protection + max_step_jump and abort_on_error flag. New small example:
```
"guards": {
  "max_step_jump_pct": 15,
  "abort_on_error": true,
  "burst_protection": {"qps_delta_pct": 30, "window": "3m"}
}
```

deploy-bot: Canary rollout draft saved by devon. Preview: https://console/redwood/rollouts/preview/abc123

jason: LGTM :+1: small nit — consider `max_ramp_per_hour` to prevent fast 100% ramps via manual overrides.

maria: agree. Also add `rollback_on_slo_violation` boolean (true by default).

devon: good catches. I'll push a PR with these fields and update the schema docs. Thanks everyone — will loop back when PR is ready.
